d: Short, messy, deep maroon hair with choppy bangs. Sharp, narrow eyes of a glowing violet shade with a stern expression on a face reflecting early adulthood. A lean, athletic build clad in full-body, dark charcoal plate armor with glowing magenta accents and a tattered white cloth sash wrapped around the waist. The ensemble is completed by a long, dark charcoal polearm emitting a vibrant magenta glow.
